questions.q: What opens into a leaf in spring?
questions.model: It is small and tight. In spring it opens. A leaf comes out. It is a bud.

questions.q: Is an oak deciduous or evergreen?
What colour are new spring leaves?
Label the tree picture: roots, trunk, branches, leaves, blossom.
questions.model: Teacher labels 'trunk' first with a straight line.

questions.q: Draw one leaf you can see today.
Why do new leaves grow in spring?
questions.a: It is warmer and lighter, so the tree can grow

questions.q: Big question: what does a tree do in spring?
questions.a: Its buds open, blossom comes out and new leaves grow
